places.name: Dalma Island
places.description: A quiet island off Abu Dhabi's western coast, once one of the Gulf's main pearl-diving centres, with the Delma Museum and old heritage houses. Getting there takes planning: drive to Jebel Dhanna, then take the Abu Dhabi Maritime ferry and check the return times, because once the last boat leaves you stay overnight.

places.name: Wadi Dahir Sulphur Pools
places.description: A short wadi hike in the Hajar Mountains past pale-blue sulphur pools with small fish, starting from the Fujairah Adventures Al Dahir trailhead. The first stretch to the pools is easy enough for families; the full loop is longer and hot, so start early and bring water. How much water there is depends on recent rain.
